item_title: City Manager's Travel to Chula Vista, California
document_text:
2.9 25-1307 City Manager's Travel to Chula Vista, California.
Authorize travel for City Manager, Jennifer A. Maguire, to Chula Vista, California, on January 8-10, 2026 to participate in the Large Cities Executive Forum.

Action: City Manager, Jennifer A. Maguire's travel to Chula Vista, California, from January 8-10, 2026, to participate in the Large Cities Executive Forum was authorized. (11-0-0)
